title: hive daemon reload output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive daemon reload --json`. Sends SIGHUP to a live, ownership-verified daemon process. Reports ok=true when the signal was delivered; ok=false (with `reason`) when reload was refused (no PID file, dead PID, reused PID, or unverified ownership). Exit codes: 0 on ok=true, 1 on ok=false.

ok.description: True only when SIGHUP was successfully delivered to the verified daemon process. False on any refusal path (with `reason` populated).

pid.description: PID that was signalled (ok=true) or the stale/refused PID inspected (ok=false). Null when no PID file was present at all.

reason.description: Why reload was refused. Present only when ok=false. not_running = no PID file at the expected path. pid_dead = PID file points at a process that no longer exists. pid_reused = process_start_time differs from recorded; the PID was reused by another process. unverified = recorded or live process_start_time is nil; ownership cannot be proved.

message.description: Human-readable explanation suitable for surfacing in operator-facing logs. Always present.
